caption: The drawing features four main objects, all rendered in shades of gray against a beige background. On the left side is a vertically oriented, ornate stand or candlestick with a spherical top, a turned central column, and three curved, decorative legs. In the upper right quadrant, there is a set of two long-handled utensils lying diagonally and crossing each other; one has a bowl-shaped end reminiscent of a ladle, and the other ends in a three-pronged fork with a decorative handle. Below these, in the bottom right, there is a partially transparent overlay of a geometric L-shaped frame outlined in faint lines, within which is positioned a smaller version of the spherical-topped stand, shown in both solid and dotted lines to indicate multiple positions. There are also two faint brown stains on the page, overlapping the bottom stand. At the bottom edge, faint text reads: "UPPER PIECES 1/1 CLEAR SIZE. LOWER PIECES 1/2 SIZE." and "THOMAS J. PEACOCK DEL."
title: Andiron and Fireplace Set
